title: GOOD NEWS
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: But the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord."

session.instruction: On Christmas Day, carry the good news — tell someone specifically why you're grateful for Jesus, and be hope to someone who is alone or hurting today.

coaching_notes: Merry Christmas. Let the gratitude in your heart be present everywhere you go today. And surprise someone by telling them something you're grateful for in them.
